_readme: THE ONE FILE THAT DRIVES THE AVAILABILITY PILL ON THE SITE.
Edit it whenever bookings actually change, commit, and the pill updates.
If this file is missing, malformed, or stale past `staleAfterDays`, the
pill silently falls back to the evergreen line below — the site never
shows a number it cannot stand behind.
slots        : how many project slots are genuinely open right now (0 is allowed)
quarter      : the quarter those slots are for, e.g. 'Q3 2026'
nextQuarter  : the quarter shown once the current one is full
updated      : ISO date you last touched this file (YYYY-MM-DD)
staleAfterDays: after this many days with no update, drop to evergreen
evergreen    : the honest, undateable fallback line
evergreen: Booking selectively · 2–3 engagements at a time
